dex.text: A long white cloud that lies along the top of a rock like a tablecloth, and pours gently down the far side without ever quite reaching the ground. It is not the weather. It is the weather's hat.
dex.fact: The Levanter is an easterly wind through the Strait of Gibraltar. Moist air blowing against the Rock is forced up its east face, cools, and condenses into a banner cloud over the summit, which spills over the western side and melts away before it reaches the town.
